system_info.cpu_topology: hybrid 8P+8E (corrected from a prior 6P+10E claim that did not arithmetic to 24 threads; verified by isolating each logical core with a pinned busy-loop probe -- see AnimusCore_v1/BENCHMARKS.md)

_note: ring_throughput above is a single historical producer-only burst run (no concurrent consumer) and is superseded, as a characterization of run-to-run variance, by the 5-run range in AnimusCore_v1/BENCHMARKS.md (6,929,317-9,565,082 pushes/sec, same producer-only methodology). Neither of those is the number for simultaneous producer+consumer load -- see sustained_mpmc_producer_consumer below.

sustained_mpmc_producer_consumer.methodology: 8 producer threads + 8 consumer threads running simultaneously (not sequential phases), sampled every 10s over a 40s window, native Windows build (g++ -O3, no sanitizers)
sustained_mpmc_producer_consumer.note: A separate short-burst benchmark (~100-200ms window) reported a bimodal 13.5M-21.4M pushes/sec range for this same configuration; investigation found no correlation with background system load, and traced it to the short window sometimes catching a transient turbo-boost state. This sustained figure is the one to cite; the burst range should not be. Single test session (one run, four samples) -- recommend a second machine and a longer window before treating this as final.
